verdict.rationale: Zero is an open-source, self-hostable email app, so a published API reference is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. The evidence shows no interactive API reference and no runnable examples. An independent check found Zero documents no public HTTP API: MCP.md is only a prose list of capabilities with no endpoint schema, authentication works by copying a browser session cookie, and no docs site resolves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
